text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Osaka Hai. Super<n>Creek is
bursting with energy from<n>doing her best for me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross drops by to cheer her<n>on by saying
she's looking forward<n>to their contest at the spring
Tenno<n>Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek heads to the track to<n>make Tamamo
Cross proud.
